lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance, circular pixel clusters are arranged in approximately six staggered horizontal rows across the mid-lateral flank, forming a semi-regular grid posterior to the branchial region.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the primary horizontal spot rows, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a macro-grid pattern across the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct horizontal ridges are visible in the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp vertical gradient with higher luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and shadow-induced lower intensity on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: The pectoral fin visible in the lower-left quadrant exhibits a significantly higher density of smaller, high-luminance spots compared to the larger, more spaced clusters on the primary lateral body.
